description: Run when unsure what an address is, before sending to it or passing it on. SOL sent to a token or program address can be lost for good. Says what any address is (wallet, token account, token, program, stake account and more) with its key facts. Example: {"address": "EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v"} is the USDC token, not a wallet. Cost: 25 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC per call (x402). Outputs explained: GET /api/tools/whats_this.

address.description: Any Solana address. The address you're about to use.

network.description: Default "mainnet-beta" (real money). "devnet" only for test wallets.

name: whats_this
